title: Cinnamon Beef Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with beef, earthy mushrooms, and warm cinnamon. Serve over rice or noodles for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the wok and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the wok and stir-fry the mushrooms until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Return the beef to the wok and stir in the cinnamon.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately over rice or noodles.
